state_owner: one F06NR owner per selected programme, with independent lane state

accepted_source_transition.commit_rule: After all five lanes and six blocks succeed, commit the complete next state once.

forward_history_after.authoritative_rule: F08 ordinary long/short transform consumes each lane's six block inputs and maintains its independent forward history; see approved identity list.

inverse_carry_after.authoritative_rule: F06NI/F06NF inverse and the F06NR overlap rule update each lane's independent carry; see approved identity list.

secondary_carrier.known_nonzero_slot_rule: Internal lanes L,C,R,Ls,Rs write inverse/overlap blocks 1 through 5 to the corresponding external row's carrier blocks 0 through 4; block 0 output is discarded after its state update.

authority_boundary.frame_index_increment: directly specified by F06NR source-frame contract
authority_boundary.carrier_zero_slots: directly specified by F06NR carrier construction contract
authority_boundary.forward_history_words: require independent F08 execution from the supplied synthetic inputs; not inferred from block-level expected outputs
authority_boundary.inverse_carry_words: require independent F06NI/F06NF plus overlap execution; not inferred from carrier routing hashes
authority_boundary.nonzero_carrier_words: require the integrated producer execution; not inferred from per-block verification results
